printed_labels.text: ST BYTES TO SIBB PER ST CTR

review_notes.evidence: Own twenty-seven native block fields and pins, every external signal/reference, main and parity rails, sixteen main and four parity AND-to-OR routes, eight control diamonds, both R terminations, unusual ST55 column107 loop beside output108/109, printed connector rows and complete footer/title inspected. Literal native AV and AM socket lines conflict with A1 and remain preserved. White abrasion in AT fields and a small group of left labels is explicitly flagged, not filled from context.
AT portion and last location glyph and several upper-left input/control label glyphs are abraded. Exact replacement cells retained. Original scan neighbors RT755 before and RT771 after.

AV literally reads F-E3L3 and AM E-E3L3; directly inspected enlarged native glyphs have straight bars and absent B bowls, unlike rounded B at AL. A1 lists B-B3L3. Literal conflicts retained for independent root inspection.
ST55 from RT541BB4 descends column107 to AL upper B12. AC output descends separately at108 to row58; AA output descends109 to row59. ST63 takes the distinct left column91 loop down to AN D11.
AE B05 output turns at column200 from row40 to row50. Diamond200/50 joins a left branch to184/50, down54 into BC D09. AB B05 row5 has diamond180/5 and the independent down26 BB termination.

validation.A1_original_native_snapshot_flags_scope: Original native-print/source-uncertainty flags retained unchanged. Current logical compatibility for source-derived repaired nodes is separately reported; direct source contradictions remain.
